reason: If the coating marks the frame or glass when it comes off, I carry the cost and the manufacturer excludes it. I run small jobs on houses and small blocks, and I can protect glazing myself with film and tape for pennies.
objection: If it marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, so I take the risk on my own margin, and I would be paying about 19 euro a m2 plus a 50% deposit for that.
instead: Cheap protection film and tape from the hardware store, my own labour, and being careful with the other trades.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee that ACHV pays for any damage to frames or glass from the coating or its removal, plus a local contractor I know who has used it.
